title: Changing fee percentage after game start can block payouts
summary: ## Severity  **Impact:** High  **Likelihood:** Low  ## Description  In `Flip.sol`, the `flip()` function calculates the `netPayout` and locks the amount to ensure that the contract has enough funds to pay the winner.
